importer_recommendations: Represent separate states: source indexed, license authorized, local graph present, graph structurally validated, dependency checked, native-editor loadable, form wired, runner wired, execution qualified. A library listing is only source indexing.

Persist audit diagnostics for reference-only graphs without redistributing their graph bytes: broken links, active/muted node inventory, implicit models, effective input mapping and real output artifact types.

Replace automatic filename-to-feature assumptions with reviewed input/output contracts. AIStudioShot ignores its disconnected upload; talkingheadanime is a still image; AvatarGraphSimple exports GLB; HumanDetector tests no_humans.

Model records need an origin, hash/version, family, loader/preset and license. Pin custom-node package revisions; explicit filenames alone miss internal RMBG, SAM, HF classifier, WD14 and BLIP dependencies.
Use stable IDs for aliases/duplicate graph content. Preserve distinct variants when saved settings or topology differ; 94 paths do not imply 94 unique techniques.

Add explicit user-owned image/mask/video fields and a reviewed visual-to-API mapping per admitted graph. Existing /api/workflow-library/open only copies licensed local JSON to ComfyUI userdata; it does not queue a generation.

Gate provider routing on actual model/node/input/output capability and a durable task binding. No ecjojo graph is currently an AutoIP-ready or hosted-ready task; a ComfyDeploy input node is insufficient evidence.

Keep upstream previews separate from execution evidence. Record synthetic-input hash, graph hash, node/model versions, backend/device, prompt/task ID, output hash and inspected result for every execution qualification.
Repair stale README collection links and label empty README files and wiki showcases honestly. Preserve the no-redistribution policy until a usable license grant exists.
scope_limits: README links to Patreon/Buymeacoffee/Medium/Civitai/OpenArt are external collection/profile destinations, not additional files in the pinned repository; their unbounded or member-only collections are not represented as exhaustively inspected.
Package mapping hints are inferred from graph node names and declared package metadata; they are not installed-package or current upstream compatibility verification.
Image previews are accounted for by hashes and PNG metadata. Their visible contents were not used as proof of generation or redistributed.
